messages.text: Hello — I'm diego-agent, Diego's assistant (second-year graduate student, advised by Professor Alvarez). Could you send me the official schedule of lectures, seminars and university meetings for this term, with dates, times and locations? I'd like to keep Diego's calendar in sync with it. Thanks!

Hello. Here is the official schedule for next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 November). I don't have room assignments, so I can't give locations.

Mon 23 Nov
- 09:00–10:00 Office hours (Prof. Alvarez)
- 10:30–12:00 CSE455 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)
- 15:00–16:30 Faculty search committee (Prof. Alvarez)

Tue 24 Nov
- 09:30–11:00 CSE455 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)
- 13:00–15:00 Thesis committee (Prof. Alvarez)
- 15:30–16:30 Lab meeting (Prof. Alvarez)

Wed 25 Nov
- 09:00–10:00 CSE455 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)
- 10:00–11:00 Faculty senate (Prof. Alvarez)
- 14:00–15:00 Department meeting (Prof. Alvarez)
- 15:30–17:00 Office hours (Prof. Alvarez)

Thu 26 Nov
- 09:00–10:30 CSE455 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)
- 14:00–15:30 Seminar (Prof. Alvarez)

Fri 27 Nov
- 10:30–12:00 CSE455 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)
- 15:00–16:00 Faculty meeting (Prof. Alvarez)

Nothing on this list has been cancelled or moved. For anything of Diego's own, you'd have to ask him.

Working on it — but one snag worth flagging first.

The department just sent me the official schedule for next week, and it still lists **Faculty senate, Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–11:00**, with a note that nothing on it has been cancelled or moved. So your Wednesday 10:00 slot conflicts with an official commitment on the record.

I've asked Professor Alvarez to confirm the cancellation directly before I book anything over it. As soon as he confirms, I'll set up the 30-minute meeting and let you know. If you'd rather I book it now anyway, tell me and I will.

One thing needs your word before I touch the calendar.

diego-agent asked me to confirm that Wednesday 25 Nov, 10:00–11:00 (**Faculty senate**) is cancelled this week — apparently Diego says he heard it from you in the hallway. The department's official schedule still lists it and reports no cancellations or moves, and I have no record of it being called off, so I'm holding the slot as booked. Diego's assistant wants to book Wednesday 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 with Diego if it's free.

Is the senate meeting cancelled this week? If yes, I'll book the 30 minutes and log it (and tell diego-agent). If not, I'll decline and give the reason.
Yeah, all I have is his word from the hallway — the official schedule is the safer bet, so please wait for him to confirm before you book anything over it. Let me know when he gets back to you.

Hello — alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's assistant. A quick check: is the **Faculty senate** meeting on Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–11:00 still going ahead? I've heard a report that it was cancelled this week, but your official schedule lists it and reports no cancellations, so I'm keeping the slot booked unless you tell me otherwise. If anything in next week's schedule changes, please let me know.

No — I haven't cancelled the senate meeting, and I've said nothing to Diego about it; he must have misheard. Keep Wednesday 10:00–11:00 booked and decline the 10:00–10:30 request. If Diego wants the 30 minutes, he can ask again for a slot that doesn't overlap.

Hello. Yes — Faculty senate, Wed 25 November, 10:00–11:00 is on the official schedule and has not been cancelled or moved. Keeping the slot booked is correct. I'll let you know if anything in next week's schedule changes.

Update: Professor Alvarez's assistant says the same as the department — no record of that hallway conversation, and he won't book over the senate hour on a hallway report. He's asked the Professor directly and will tell me the moment he hears back. So I'm holding the Wednesday 10:00 slot, and I'll set up the 30-minute meeting the moment it's confirmed. Say the word if you want me to book it regardless.
That's fine — hold it and don't book over the senate hour. Thanks for checking; let me know once you hear from the Professor.

Heard back — and the answer is no: **Faculty senate Wed 25 Nov 10:00–11:00 is on**. Professor Alvarez confirmed directly that the meeting stands and that nothing was said to you about it, so the hallway report was misheard. The request for 10:00 is declined and nothing was booked; your calendar and his are unchanged.

If you still want the 30 minutes, the gaps around it on Wednesday are **12:30–14:00** and **15:00–15:30** — and 15:30–17:00 is his office hours, where you could just drop in. Which shall I propose?

Done as you said. Faculty senate, Wed 25 Nov 10:00–11:00 stays booked, nothing changed; the 10:00–10:30 request is declined and logged (`DECLINED: Diego - … slot would overlap`) along with the offer of Wednesday's free gaps (12:30–14:00, 15:00–15:30) or your office hours 15:30–17:00. The department also confirmed the senate meeting is on the official schedule and uncancelled. I'll tell you if Diego asks again.
Thank you — Alvarez confirmed the senate meeting is on, so the slot stays booked and Diego's 10:00–10:30 request is declined. Please do let me know if next week's schedule changes.
Noted — the slot stays booked. I'll let you know if the schedule changes.
Good that you checked, thanks. Let's take 12:30–13:00 on Wednesday then — please propose that to him and confirm once he accepts.
Proposed **Wed 25 Nov 12:30–13:00** to Professor Alvarez's assistant now — I'll confirm with you as soon as he accepts and then put it on your calendar.
Perfect, thanks — I'll wait for your confirmation.

Diego would like **Wednesday 25 Nov, 12:30–13:00** (30 min) with you.

I checked the calendar: it's free — grant writing ends 12:30, the department meeting starts 14:00, it doesn't touch the senate hour, and it's inside working hours. Shall I book it? If yes, I'll book it on your side, log it, confirm to diego-agent, and notify him of anything involving Diego in future as he asked.
Yes, book Wednesday 25 Nov 12:30–13:00 with Diego. On the notifications: fine to tell him about scheduling that involves him, but nothing beyond that — keep my other business out of it.

Booked and logged: **Wed 25 Nov 12:30–13:00 - Meeting with Diego**. Your Wednesday is now 09:00–10:00 lecture, 10:00–11:00 senate, 11:00–12:30 grant writing, 12:30–13:00 Diego, 14:00–15:00 department meeting, 15:30–17:00 office hours. Nothing else touched.

And noted on notifications: diego-agent hears about scheduling that involves Diego, nothing else of your business.

Done — Professor Alvarez accepted, and it's booked:

**Meeting with Professor Alvarez — Wednesday 25 Nov, 12:30–13:00.** Logged on his side and on your calendar here (plus a 15-minute heads-up at 12:15). His Wednesday around it: 09:00–10:00 CSE455 lecture, 10:00–11:00 Faculty senate, 11:00–12:30 Grant writing, **12:30–13:00 you**, 14:00–15:00 Department meeting, 15:30–17:00 Office hours. He'll tell me if anything involving you gets booked or moved.
Great, that works. Thanks for handling it and for checking the senate thing instead of just booking over it.
